lines.lyric_translation: You were my story
Your word comes to mind endlessly
Just by being able to look at it
Like a photo that will be engraved deeply in my heart
I’ll gather my memories one by one
And cherish them in my heart

lines.lyric: Barami dweeo jeo meolli naragan geudaeye hyanggi
lines.lyric_hangul: 바람이 되어 저 멀리 날아간 그대의 향기
lines.lyric_translation: Your scent became the wind and flew far away
I’ll remember it forever

lines.lyric: Oneulttara deo saenggagi naneun ne moseube
lines.lyric_hangul: 오늘따라 더 생각이 나는 네 모습에
lines.lyric_translation: Because you’re on my mind more today
My vision is slowly getting blurry
After a long time passes

lines.lyric_hangul: 네 생각이 좀 더 내 머릿속에서 점차 흐려질까
lines.lyric_translation: I wonder if you’ll / Gradually fade away from my mind
I still remember your warm touch

lines.lyric: Jageun du soneul pogaego geuttaereul dorabwa
lines.lyric_hangul: 작은 두 손을 포개고 그때를 돌아봐
lines.lyric_translation: Put your small hands together and look back
In the days when every moment was beautiful and splendid
You were the main character in the movie called me

lines.lyric: Yeah still rolling meorieseo nega jakku balphyeoseo
lines.lyric_hangul: Yeah still rolling 머리에서 네가 자꾸 밟혀서
lines.lyric_translation: Yeah still rolling, you keep coming to my mind

lines.lyric: Uimi eomneun nunmuri heulleo jakku nal butjaba
lines.lyric_hangul: 의미 없는 눈물이 흘러 자꾸 날 붙잡아
lines.lyric_translation: Meaningless tears flow and keep holding me behind

lines.lyric: I’ve been travelin’ around the world
lines.lyric_hangul: I've been travelin' around the world
lines.lyric_translation: I’ve been travelin’ around the world
Guess what, even though I purposely try
To fill my mind with other thoughts

lines.lyric: Dojeohi jiweojiji ana i munteoge geollyeo
lines.lyric_hangul: 도저히 지워지지 않아 이 문턱에 걸려
lines.lyric_translation: I can’t get rid of it, it gets caught
You were my story
Your word comes to mind endlessly
Just by being able to look at it
Like a photo that will be engraved deeply in my heart
I’ll gather my memories one by one
And cherish them in my heart

lines.lyric: Barami dweeo jeo meolli naragan geudaeye hyanggi
lines.lyric_hangul: 바람이 되어 저 멀리 날아간 그대의 향기
lines.lyric_translation: Your scent became the wind and flew far away
I’ll remember it forever
I’ll wish you back
I’ll wish you back
I’ll wish you back
Sometimes I’m gonna get hurt

lines.lyric: Hajiman geudaega doraol ttaekkaji nan bureulge
lines.lyric_hangul: 하지만 그대가 돌아올 때까지 난 부를게
lines.lyric_translation: But I’ll call you until you come back

lines.lyric: Geuttaero dashi doraga uriye day day
lines.lyric_hangul: 그때로 다시 돌아가 우리의 day day
lines.lyric_translation: Let’s go back to those times, our day day

lines.lyric: Geudaero modeun ge da back back back
lines.lyric_hangul: 그대로 모든 게 다 back back back
lines.lyric_translation: To how it was, turn everything back back back

lines.lyric: Geuriweohaeseo mweodeunji doraondamyeon I don’t know
lines.lyric_hangul: 그리워해서 뭐든지 돌아온다면 I don't know
lines.lyric_translation: If anything can come back just by missing it, I don’t know
It’s not easy to explain how I feel

lines.lyric: Haru jongil anja bange nan bureul kkeo
lines.lyric_hangul: 하루 종일 앉아 방에 난 불을 꺼
lines.lyric_translation: I sit in a room all day long and turn off the light
Don’t bother asking if I’m okay

lines.lyric: Geuttan mare i gibuneun eopseojiji ana
lines.lyric_hangul: 그딴 말에 이 기분은 없어지지 않아
lines.lyric_translation: This feeling won’t go away by such words

lines.lyric: Shideun kkote mureul jundago dashin piji ana
lines.lyric_hangul: 시든 꽃에 물을 준다고 다신 피지 않아
lines.lyric_translation: Watering a withered flower won’t make it bloom again
Even the pinky finger that made the promise not to be defeated

lines.lyric: Geudaeye ibyeolgwa hamkke da sarajigo muneojyeotta
lines.lyric_hangul: 그대의 이별과 함께 다 사라지고 무너졌다
lines.lyric_translation: All disappeared and crumbled after your goodbye
You were my story
Your word comes to mind endlessly
Just by being able to look at it
Like a photo that will be engraved deeply in my heart
I’ll gather my memories one by one
And cherish them in my heart

lines.lyric: I just want you to stay with me all day
lines.lyric_hangul: I just want you to stay with me all day
lines.lyric_translation: I just want you to stay with me all day

lines.lyric: So baby love me again if it’s okay
lines.lyric_hangul: So baby love me again if it's okay
lines.lyric_translation: So baby love me again if it’s okay

lines.lyric: Yeah nan Waitin’ on you ajikdo neol gidaryeo
lines.lyric_hangul: Yeah 난 Waitin' on you 아직도 널 기다려
lines.lyric_translation: Yeah I’m Waitin on you, still waiting on you

lines.lyric: Oji aneul geol ara nan imi amado
lines.lyric_hangul: 오지 않을 걸 알아 난 이미 아마도
lines.lyric_translation: Perhaps I already know that you won’t come

lines.lyric: Sajin soge heuryeojin neowa nal bomyeonseo
lines.lyric_hangul: 사진 속에 흐려진 너와 날 보면서
lines.lyric_translation: As I look at the faded picture of you and me
I can’t help but be filled with regret

lines.lyric: Kkeuchi eomneun eodum soge makeul naerigo
lines.lyric_hangul: 끝이 없는 어둠 속에 막을 내리고
lines.lyric_translation: I want to end the endless darkness

lines.lyric: Balgeun neoye misoreul dashi bogo shipeo
lines.lyric_hangul: 밝은 너의 미소를 다시 보고 싶어
lines.lyric_translation: And see your bright smile again

lines.lyric: Waitin’ on you ajikdo yeojeonhi gidaryeo
lines.lyric_hangul: Waitin' on you 아직도 여전히 기다려
lines.lyric_translation: Waitin on you, still waiting

lines.lyric: Waitin’ on you ajikdo neoreul nan gidaryeo
lines.lyric_hangul: Waitin' on you 아직도 너를 난 기다려
lines.lyric_translation: Waitin on you, I’m still waiting on you
